name: scanmycv
description: ScanMyCv monorepo root scripts for local full-stack development and testing

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
